name: nafkah-video
description: Video promosi Nafkah (Remotion). Terpisah dari build aplikasi.

scripts.render: remotion render Teaser out/nafkah-teaser-raw.mp4 && node scripts/master.mjs out/nafkah-teaser-raw.mp4 out/nafkah-teaser.mp4
scripts.render:nomusic: remotion render Teaser out/nafkah-teaser-tanpa-musik-raw.mp4 --props=props-nomusic.json && node scripts/master.mjs out/nafkah-teaser-tanpa-musik-raw.mp4 out/nafkah-teaser-tanpa-musik.mp4
scripts.render:16x9: remotion render Teaser16x9 out/nafkah-teaser-16x9-raw.mp4 && node scripts/master.mjs out/nafkah-teaser-16x9-raw.mp4 out/nafkah-teaser-16x9.mp4
